## Life Summary

Timothy Neil Telfer — Mark's father. Son of Murray & Shirley. First married Penny Ann Virgen on 28 November 1981 at Redcliffe Churches of Christ Chapel, Kippa Ring (divorced). Married Sheryle Telfer on 28 August 1999 at Pine Rivers Baptist Church, Lawnton. Theologically trained, with studies at Malyon Theological College and Tov Human Flourishing.
